WITH BIZ_BASE AS ( ), BIZ AS ( /*--- 이익제공 ---*/ SELECT biz01_provide_rcv_type , COALESCE(biz02_target_company_nm,'*미등록*') biz01_target_company_nm , COALESCE(biz02_target_emp_nm,'*미등록*') biz01_target_emp_nm , biz01_average_price , biz90_company_limit2 FROM BIZ_BASE LEFT OUTER JOIN biz02_person a ON a.biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id WHERE biz01_provide_rcv_type = '1' AND COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') != 'true' AND biz01_average_price > (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,2,1) = '0' THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit1 /* 일반 */ ELSE biz90_sale_rule_limit2 END) /* 경조 */ /*--- 이익제공(거래상대방 미등록) ---*/ UNION ALL SELECT biz01_provide_rcv_type , '*미등록*' biz01_target_company_nm , '*미등록*' biz01_target_emp_nm , biz01_average_price , biz90_company_limit2 FROM BIZ_BASE WHERE biz01_provide_rcv_type = '1' AND biz01_average_price > (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,2,1) = '0' THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit1 /* 일반 */ ELSE biz90_sale_rule_limit2 END) /* 경조 */ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id AND biz02_target_emp_nm IS NOT NULL) /*--- 이익수령 ---*/ UNION ALL SELECT biz01_provide_rcv_type , f_get_company_nm(biz01_company_id) biz01_target_company_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(biz02_emp_id) biz01_target_emp_nm , biz01_average_price , biz90_company_limit2 FROM BIZ_BASE LEFT OUTER JOIN biz02_person a ON a.biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id WHERE biz01_provide_rcv_type = '2' AND COALESCE(biz02_emp_yn,'false') = 'true' AND biz01_average_price > (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,2,1) = '0' THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit1 /* 일반 */ ELSE biz90_sale_rule_limit2 END) /* 경조 */
/*--- 이익수령(직원정보 미등록) ---*/ UNION ALL SELECT biz01_provide_rcv_type , f_get_company_nm(biz01_company_id) biz01_target_company_nm , '*미등록*' biz01_target_emp_nm , biz01_average_price , biz90_company_limit2 FROM BIZ_BASE WHERE biz01_provide_rcv_type = '2' AND biz01_average_price > (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(biz01_provide_pur_cd,2,1) = '0' THEN biz90_sale_rule_limit1 /* 일반 */ ELSE biz90_sale_rule_limit2 END) /* 경조 */ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz02_person WHERE biz02_promo_id = biz01_promo_id AND biz02_emp_id IS NOT NULL) ) SELECT f_cdnm('ProvideRcvType', biz01_provide_rcv_type, #{companyId}, f_today()) AS provide_rcv_type_name , biz01_target_company_nm AS target_company_name , biz01_target_emp_nm AS target_emp_name , biz01_average_price AS average_price FROM ( SELECT biz01_provide_rcv_type , biz01_target_company_nm , biz01_target_emp_nm , SUM(biz01_average_price) biz01_average_price , biz90_company_limit2 FROM BIZ GROUP BY biz01_provide_rcv_type , biz01_target_company_nm , biz01_target_emp_nm , biz90_company_limit2 ) a WHERE biz01_average_price > biz90_company_limit2 ORDER BY biz01_provide_rcv_type , biz01_target_company_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc , biz01_target_emp_nm
